sentences.text:
Order 
This is second bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C./483 of BNSS,
2023 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.701/2022, registered at P.S.- Kotwali, District Dindori (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 365, 366, 376 (2)(n), 506 of IPC and Section 5/6 and 17 of the POCSO Act, 2012.

2. Applicant's first bail application was dismissed vide order dated 17.10.2023 passed in M.Cr.C.
No.39308 of 2023.

3. As prayed by learned counsel for the applicant, this second application too under Section 439 of Cr.P.C./483 of BNSS, 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.
4. However, it cannot be overlooked that applicant is in jail since 14.03.2023.

Therefore, learned trial Court is directed to expedite the pace of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:60770 2 MCRC-47997-2024 the trial & conclude it expeditiously preferably within a period of six months from today by fixing it either on day to day basis or by giving short adjournments and by issuing coercive processes, if witnesses are not turning up despite service of processes.
